services_heading: Complete Electrical Services Across Liverpool and Wirral

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, flickering lights, or dead sockets? We respond quickly to electrical faults and get you back to normal. Most jobs fixed same day.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring puts your home at risk. We replace outdated installations with modern safe cabling, new consumer units, and full testing to Building Regulations.

services.title: Boiler and Heating Electrics
services.desc: Installing or upgrading your heating system? We handle all electrical work for boilers, heat pumps, and immersion heaters to manufacturer spec.

services.title: Electric Vehicle Charging
services.desc: Future-proof your home with a fast, safe EV charger installation. We size the supply, install the wall unit, and test everything thoroughly.

services.title: Commercial and Industrial Work
services.desc: Retail fit-outs, office refurbishments, factory maintenance. We understand downtime costs money — we work efficiently and stick to schedules.

services.title: Periodic Testing and Inspection
services.desc: Landlords and letting agents: we carry out EICR surveys and provide detailed reports to keep your properties compliant and insurable.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, do the job right, and never try to sell you work you don't need.
about_para_1: AW Electrical Northwest Ltd was founded on a simple idea: homeowners and businesses deserve honest, skilled electrical work without the nonsense. Over 18 years, we've grown from a single van to a team of qualified electricians serving Liverpool, Wirral, and beyond. Every member of our team is fully trained and tested — no shortcuts, no cowboys.
about_para_2: We're known in our community for turning up when we say we will, fixing things properly the first time, and charging fair prices with no surprises. Our repeat customer rate says it all — most of our work comes from people who've used us before and trust us. When you call AW Electrical, you get honest advice and fast, professional work.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool and Wirral Customers Say

reviews.text: Had an absolute nightmare with an old fuse box — kept tripping out without warning. Called AW Electrical and they came out within two hours. Really explained what was wrong, sorted a new consumer unit and full testing same day. Brilliant, fair price and no messing about.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed an EV charger installed and weren't sure about the electrics. The team assessed the supply, installed everything properly, and walked us through how to use it. They even gave us a guarantee on the work. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: As a lettings agent managing several properties, I use AW Electrical for all EICR inspections and repairs. They're quick, thorough, and the reports are detailed enough for insurance. They've never let us down.
reviews.author: David L.
